title: Bobr Studio — we build games and apps log by log
meta_desc: Bobr Studio is a tiny indie studio building cozy strategy games and handy apps for your phone.
hero_p: Bobr Studio is a tiny indie studio. Like beavers, we build slowly and carefully — cozy strategy games that are hard to put down and handy apps that just work.
dots_desc: Surround your rival's dots: Classic and Adventure with gold, forests and rivers.
next_text: The beavers are already gnawing on it. 🪵
v1_text: We polish every game and app like a beaver polishes a dam: carefully, log by log.
v2_text: Skill wins. No pay-to-win and no dark patterns — just a good game.
v3_text: Short games for a coffee break, long ones for a rainy evening — even without internet.
game_meta: Dots RPG — the classic pen-and-paper game of dots, plus an Adventure mode with gold, forests, rivers, tricks and buildings.
game_intro: The classic game of dots from the back of a school notebook — now with an Adventure mode: gold, forests, rivers, tricks, buildings and a clever opponent. Surround your rival's dots and conquer the map.
banner_alt: Dots RPG — surround, capture, conquer the map

f3: Play a bot or a friend on one phone
